text_block_list.name: My Holiday Joy
text_block_list.text:
Christmas: a thick slice of cake. 
A day to let loose just a little, as a 
reward for the year.

text_block_list.name: My Holiday Joy
text_block_list.text:
Christmas: a satin ribbon. 
A day to wrap up all your love and give it 
to someone precious.

text_block_list.name: My Holiday Joy
text_block_list.text:
Christmas: a bubble that pops and 
vanishes. 
A day where a fleeting spark peeks through 
the bottom of dull, lingering sweet 
nectar.

text_block_list.name: My Holiday Joy
text_block_list.text: Christmas: it is————

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...*I'm* the director in charge 
of this year's Christmas event?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We would like to ask the two of you 
to plan and organize this year's "Mejiro 
Christmas Night."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm... like, why me? 
Ah, not that I don't wanna do it! Just 
wondering if I'm really okay for the 
job...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(—I mean, when you say "Mejiro Christmas 
Night"...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's that special event to show 
appreciation to all the fans supporting 
the Mejiro family. 
A seriously prestigious deal where even 
all the big shots come out to entertain 
the guests.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's got a legendary history that goes 
way back before we were even born. 
A vital piece of Mejiro culture and 
tradition... and you want *me* to...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I totally get how important Mejiro 
Christmas Night is. 
So why me...? As you can see, I'm pretty 
casual and rough around the edges, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the other director in charge— 
she gave you her strongest recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Lady Palmer, it is I~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I volunteered to be the director of 
"Mejiro Christmas Night." 
I look forward to working with you~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bright! ...A recommendation? You 
recommended me? 
...Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because I thought that with you, Lady 
Palmer, we could make it super hype and 
wild and woo-hoo~? 
A woooonderfully marvelous Christmas 
event~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not with anyone else. 
I truly wish to create it together with 
you, Lady Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
We have no objections either. 
What do you say? —Will you accept?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that a no...? Not feeling up to it? Too 
busy...? 
If so, I shall swallow my tears and 
prepare to fight this battle all on my 
own~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I can't say no to that! 
If I backed down after all that, I'd lose 
my party animal cred!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, how wonderful~ Lady Party Animal~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So yeah!... The two of us will give it our 
all 
as the directors of Mejiro Christmas 
Night!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So Bright and Palmer are the 
directors 
for this year's Mejiro Christmas Night!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep, though we haven't decided a single 
thing yet. Come to think of it, 
Ryan, you and McQueen ran it together 
before, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It was the "All-Mejiro Dinner Show," 
wasn't it~? 
There was singing, dancing, and even our 
own indie film—it was quite delightful~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, the movie about the Mejiro family 
history starring McQueen! 
The family's supervision was super strict, 
huh? But it was totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... the event that really left an 
impression on me 
was the one Lady Ramonu and Lady Ardan 
organized!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A retrospective of each Umamusume's 
races... 
And after watching the race footage, Lady 
Ramonu said we should have a race right 
then and there—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well, love was overflowing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Clashing with our rawest passions... It 
was a marvelous night. 
Were you not there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes... I was far too intimidated...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan, big sister. Do you remember the 
lantern exchange event 
we had during Christmas Night long ago...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I was holding Bright and Dober 
by the hands... 
Hehe, you two were so adorable back then!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Bright, Dober! 
Let's go get our presents together!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They said we gotta trade these green 
lanterns with other kids 
and bring back white lanterns instead!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, those kids over there have white 
lanterns! 
There are two of them, so you two go trade 
with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: ...N-No... It's scary...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, scary, huh...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeees... *yaaaawn*... mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! Watch out, Bright! Look where 
you're going! 
Jeez... Wait here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Here, I got them exchanged for the two of 
you, too! 
...Hopefully next time, you can ask for 
them yourselves. I'm sure you two will be 
able to do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, talking about it is really making it 
feel like Christmas! 
...Oops, I've gotta run soon. I'm super 
excited for the event!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, got it! Leave it to us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. I shall do my absolute best~.
